title: neottia microphylla
intro: Neottia microphylla, commonly known as the small-leaf ladies' tresses, is a species of orchid native to North America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can aid in the treatment of conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Neottia microphylla include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce pain and inflammation, and act as an antiseptic. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
